accessNotes: BrightFunded payout re-read 2026-10-16 via WebFetch (non-US egress): help article dated March 18, 2026 and brightfunded.com homepage.

evidence.quote: You can request your first Reward Split after 30 days after you place your first trade on your Funded Account. After your first Reward Split, you can request a Reward Split bi-weekly (14 days).
You can select the following add-ons at the checkout for fastest and bigger payouts: ⚡️ Bi-weeky add-on (Payouts every 14 days) ⚡️ Weekly add-on (Payouts every 7 days)

payoutFrequency.summary: First Reward Split 30 days after the first funded trade, then every 14 days; 7-day (weekly) cycle via paid add-on
payoutFrequency.note: The official payout article contradicts itself: it says that after the first Reward Split you can request bi-weekly (14 days) by default, yet also sells a 'Bi-weeky add-on (Payouts every 14 days)' alongside the weekly add-on. It is unclear whether 14-day payouts are standard or require the add-on. The homepage advertises 'Weekly Payouts Available' (add-on).
